description: This file defines API declarations for managing WAN interfaces, including starting/stopping the WAN state machine, activating, and deactivating interfaces.

methods.name: WanMgr_StartWanVISM
methods.description: Starts the WAN interface state machine for a specified interface index with a given selection status.

methods.name: WanMgr_StopWanVISM
methods.description: Stops the WAN interface state machine and sets the selection status to not selected.

methods.name: WanMgr_ActivateInterface
methods.description: Activates the specified WAN interface, configuring route, firewall, DNS, and setting the interface to active state.

methods.name: WanMgr_DeactivateInterface
methods.description: Deactivates the specified WAN interface, removing configurations and transitioning it to standby.
